hospital: Providers and facilities (uninsured or self-pay patients)
title: 45 CFR 149.620, patient-provider dispute resolution

ppdr-400-over-estimate.quote: Substantially in excess means, with respect to the total billed charges by a provider or facility, an amount that is at least $400 more than the total amount of expected charges listed on the good faith estimate for the provider or facility.
